pages.title: [Global keyboard shortcuts]
pages.purpose: App-wide desktop shortcut layer installed above the navigator in MaterialApp.builder (main.dart:1198). Each binding accepts Control or Meta. Surfaces mixing in AppShortcutSurface may claim an intent first (AppShortcutSignals.dispatch, newest first, current route only); otherwise the shell fallback below runs.
gates: desktopInteractions (platformCapabilities.isDesktop); AppShortcuts returns child untouched otherwise

pages.title: {server name} · Work / Inbox / Project / Settings
pages.purpose: Main product shell for a connected server: app bar whose server name and status open the server switcher, current tab title, connection banner, and four retained root destinations, one per noun (Work, Inbox, Project, Settings), shown as a bottom glass dock (<760dp) or a NavigationRail (>=760dp).
gates: named route '/home' is ungated; via '/' requires conn.profile != null && conn.hasConnectedServer

elements.label: Ctrl/Cmd+1 … 4
elements.effect: onAppShortcut(SelectDestinationIntent): _selectTab(_safeTab(index, conn.capabilities)); the index is the visible position (1 Work, 2 Inbox, 3 Project, 4 Settings).

elements.label: Ctrl/Cmd+F
elements.effect: onAppShortcut(FindInSurfaceIntent): bumps _findInFiles; ProjectHub opens Files and focuses its search field.

elements.label: Ctrl/Cmd+`
elements.effect: onAppShortcut(OpenTerminalIntent): Navigator.push(MaterialPageRoute(TerminalPage(controller: conn))).

elements.label: Work
elements.effect: _selectTab(_workTab): shows WorkspaceScreen(controller: conn) in the RetainedTabView. Rendered as NavigationBar destination (<760dp wide, keyboard closed) or NavigationRail destination (>=760dp, extended at >=1040dp).

elements.label: Inbox
elements.effect: _selectTab(_inboxTab): shows ActivityScreen(controller: conn, embedded: true). The icon carries Badge key 'activity-pending-badge' with conn.unifiedAttentionCount (permissions, questions, forms, AI Team gates, other servers' pending counts) when > 0; no badge at zero.

elements.label: Project
elements.effect: _selectTab(_projectTab): shows ProjectHub(controller, focusSearchSignal: _findInFiles, backController: _projectBack). _safeTab falls back to Work when the server offers no project tool.
gates: ProjectHub.isAvailable(conn.capabilities): fileBrowsing || terminal || projectManagement (destination hidden and body replaced by SizedBox.shrink otherwise, e.g. Codex and Paseo)

elements.label: Settings
elements.effect: _selectTab(_settingsTab): shows the Settings hub, SettingsScreen(controller: conn, embedded: true).
